title: Development of a digital, accessible, patient-centered oral health education program for individuals with nephrological and rheumatological conditions
summary: The study investigates how oral health can be improved in people with inflammatory rheumatic diseases and in people with advanced chronic kidney disease. To this end, a digital educational and learning program is being used to inform participants about oral health and encourage them to adopt better oral health habits. The study will assess whether this leads to improvements in oral hygiene and the quality of dental and periodontal care.

interventions.name: Nephrology and rheumatology patients will first receive a validated oral health questionnaire (baseline) and then digital informational materials on oral health. Throughout the study, patients’ oral health will be assessed regularly using the questionnaire.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
rheumatoid arthritis (seronegative or seropositive), seronegative spondyloarthropathy, or chronic kidney disease of any cause at stage 4 or 5 according to KDIGO 2024.
Exclusion criteria:
Pregnancy, acute kidney injury requiring temporary dialysis, short-term terminal illness managed with palliative care
